entities.summary: Huanglong Sports Center Stadium, or Yellow Dragon Sports Center Stadium, is a multi-purpose stadium in the center of the city of Hangzhou, Zhejiang, China, home to Chinese Super League club Zhejiang Professional. Huanglong means "yellow dragon" in Chinese. It is also used for cultural events such as music concerts and celebrations.
